leverage_and_whether_the_stop_is_reachab.meaning: A 34.2% adverse move at 7x is about 2.4 times initial margin (notional/leverage). On isolated margin a position is often liquidated before a stop that far away. Cosmas margin mode is unknown. Do not assume the posted SL fills.

behavior: Maybe sends a parsed Telegram signal to Bitunix slots. Default env FXGLITCH_AUTO_TRADE is on unless set to 0/false/no. Disabled when VERCEL is set.
Slots from FXGLITCH_AUTO_SLOTS default '2'. Allowed slot ids 1, 2, 3.
One fill record per telegram_id. Messages older than 4 hours are skipped when posted_at parses.

Requires a stop and a take-profit after live_entry_check. Stop-adjustment with no stop is skipped. A stop-adjustment that still has a parsed stop is not explicitly blocked in maybe_execute; the parser warning exists but auto_trade does not check can_open. A recommending agent must still not treat 'adjust your sl' as a new entry.
Stake: FXGLITCH_AUTO_RISK default 5. That figure is collateral (margin), not distance-to-stop risk. qty ≈ margin * leverage / entry.
Leverage: passes the signal through plans.TIERS daredevil: leverage_mult 2, floor 15, cap 25. A 7x Cosmas post becomes 15x before the instrument cap, unless FXGLITCH_AUTO_LEV forces another integer.
Margin mode CROSS. Client id prefix fxg-auto-.
live_entry_check (plans.py): mark must sit strictly between SL and TP, live reward/risk at least 1, and mark must not already have covered ~80% of the original entry-to-TP span.

recommend_tiers_not_used_by_auto.note: recommend() builds four tiers. Auto-trade forces daredevil only. Tiers change size and leverage, not the signal stop. Win/loss fields are this setup's R, not a historical win rate.

trail_note.this_is_not_a_cosmas_close: A 200% (or 100%) ROI trail is FX-GLITCH position management. Cosmas never wrote a 200% close or a trail. Do not score a trail ratchet as his take-profit. Do not close a 'Cosmas style' recommendation at +200% ROI unless a real Cosmas message says so. None does.
trail_note.what_the_code_does: ROI = (mark-entry)/entry * leverage * 100 for a long. STEP defaults to env FXGLITCH_TRAIL_STEP or 100. When ROI crosses another STEP, the stop is ratcheted and never moved against the position. First step (ROI >= 100 with the default) locks breakeven. Next step locks the prior STEP percent of ROI. The module docstring instead says breakeven at 200% and lock 200% at 400%. Filename says 200. Trust the code default (100) unless the deployed env sets FXGLITCH_TRAIL_STEP. Either number is the desk's trail, not his exit.
trail_note.alerts: The tool can POST a WhatsApp alert via the local desk. That path is operational and out of scope for a recommendation card.

steps.action: Parse only real text with the signal_copy rules. Drop education, Naira/cash promos, affiliate footers, duplicate pastes, and demo BTC.

If the text is a dated Cosmas entry with CMP, one side, one SL, one TP, and leverage, recommend THAT trade only as a copy of his levels. Re-check the live Bitunix mark. If mark is beyond SL or TP, say the level is already traded through and do not refresh the entry. If the message is older than the event it describes, say so.
If the text says adjust SL, output a management note (new stop, symbol) and stop. Do not open a position from Tp/Sl numbers sitting in that same message.
If the text says targeting long but has no CMP and no numeric entry, do not invent an entry. PONS is the example. can_open is false.

All must be true: mark at least 80% below the 180-day high (PIPPIN was about 97.8% below 0.90759); mark within 25% of the 90-day low; 24h quote volume enough for a small futures order, else skip the book; proposed SL = lowest daily low of about 120 days, then about 6% above that low, and that SL must be 20-45% under the mark; proposed TP = 180-365 day high rounded down to one significant figure and at least 5x the mark.
